name: Milia Elifard
original_name: ミリア・エリファード
source:
A knight of Granleyd who has achieved the most prestigious rank of 'Holy Dragon Knight'. She feels the immense weight of responsibility that comes from being a Miko of the Divine Beast, but doesn't let it slow her down as she continues to wield her sword to protect the innocent. A kindhearted and noble knight, she is also one of the few people who knew Theofrad during his days as a researcher in the Numerology Institute.

[From the [url=https://ninetail.info/CF/VenusBloodGAIA_International/en18_character.html]official website[/url]]
